Man: Hello Sarah, I am calling from Apex Construction to discuss wholesale pricing for raw steel materials on our upcoming project.
Woman: Good morning, David. As you know, steel prices have been volatile, but we can offer a twelve percent discount if your company orders a minimum of five hundred metric tons.
Man: That works for our schedule. I will consult my procurement team and submit an updated formal purchase order by 3:00 PM today.
Woman: Perfect. Once I receive the purchase order, I will lock in the discounted rate and schedule the initial shipment.

MEMORANDUM
To: All Department Heads
From: Rachel Adams, VP of Human Resources
Date: January 15
Subject: Implementation of Core Collaboration Hours

Beginning February 1, our company will transition to a flexible hybrid work schedule. All full-time employees are required to be online and available for synchronous team meetings during our designated 'Core Hours' of 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM Eastern Time. Outside of these hours, staff may arrange their work schedules as they see fit, provided the mandatory 40-hour weekly total is fulfilled. Department supervisors must approve all individual telecommuting agreements by January 25.

Business Weekly — August 22
Retail Giants Embrace Micro-Warehouses to Accelerate Deliveries

Urban logistics is undergoing a massive transformation as major e-commerce retailers establish micro-fulfillment hubs inside metropolitan city centers. By converting underutilized downtown retail spaces into automated storage facilities, companies can fulfill customer grocery and household orders in as little as 30 minutes. Last quarter, retail leader MetroMart opened twelve micro-centers across Atlanta and recorded a 45% increase in repeat customer orders. Industry analysts predict urban micro-warehousing will capture over 25% of national grocery logistics within five years.
questions.questionText: What trend is described in the article?

options.label: A
options.text: Establishing automated micro-warehouses in city centers

options.label: B
options.text: Closing physical supermarkets to cut labor costs

options.label: C
options.text: Replacing delivery vans with electric bicycles

options.label: D
options.text: Outsourcing food delivery to third-party apps
